pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH donor_counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS donation_count FROM "donations" GROUP BY "Donor"), multi_donors AS (SELECT "Donor" FROM donor_counts WHERE donation_count > 1), total_donations AS (SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donations"), multi_amount AS (SELECT SUM("Amount") AS multi_amount FROM "donations" WHERE "Donor" IN (SELECT "Donor" FROM multi_donors)) SELECT (m.multi_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_amount, 0)) AS percent, m.multi_amount AS number_of_donors FROM multi_amount AS m CROSS JOIN total_donations AS t

CURRENT QUESTION:
out of all donation rupees collected, what fraction came from donors who contributed on more than one occasion - give percent and the number of such donors
attempts.response:
WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    "Donor",
    COUNT(*) AS donation_count
  FROM "donations"
  GROUP BY "Donor"
),
multi_donors AS (
  SELECT
    "Donor"
  FROM donor_counts
  WHERE donation_count > 1
),
total_donations AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("Amount") AS total_amount
  FROM "donations"
),
multi_amount AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("Amount") AS multi_amount
  FROM "donations"
  WHERE "Donor" IN (SELECT "Donor" FROM multi_donors)
)
SELECT
  (m.multi_amount * 100.0 / t.total_amount) AS percent,
  m.multi_amount AS number_of_donors
FROM multi_amount m
CROSS JOIN total_donations t;
